relationships.subject: DHPG
relationships.evidence_quote: correlated with activation of extracellular signal-regulated kinases ERK1 and ERK2 in the spinal cord

relationships.subject: MPEP
relationships.evidence_quote: Microinjection of mGluR5 NAM (MPEP), but not mGluR1 NAM (CPG), resulted in a dose-dependent inhibition of the agonist (exogenous glutamate, DHPG or CHPG)-induced mechanical hyperalgesia

key_findings: Review: mGluR1 and mGluR5 blockade is antinociceptive in rodent pain models; mGluR5 drives peripheral hyperalgesia and has region-specific roles in brain.
